scope: Composition v4 only: Frontier v5 release 1 is the F5 family, six admitted tasks at equal weight 1/6 (PLAN-v4.md, plan-v4.json), with an optional F4 extension decided by (l). F1, F2, F3 and unfilled F4 slots move to a later release with its own plan. Every other part of PLAN.md and PLAN-v2.md applies unchanged. A blueprint for the release, not the runnable suite lock (tasks/frontier-v5/suite.lock.json is written at release freeze).

confirmed_decisions.j: Adopt composition v4: Frontier v5 release 1 is the six admitted F5 tasks; F1 to F3 and unfilled F4 slots move to release 2. Confirmed by the owner in chat 2026-10-31.

open_decisions_policy: Resolved through dated docs/DECISIONS.md entries citing this freeze, never by editing frozen files. Further capacity, weight or slot changes require a new plan with its own freeze.
known_outcomes_available: Six F5 tasks admitted at the gate (GATE-LOG.md, 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-30). Every non-F5 candidate gated so far was rejected on the GPT-6 Astra half (comrak, phonenumbers, apollo, ferrycore 0.1.0). bothycore and ferrycore 0.2.0 are in the gate at freeze time. No confirmation run has been made.
